High-pressure CsCl-type B2 KCl, stored separately from the rock-salt B1 phase. The lattice is normalized to the fictive zero-pressure V0 of the default Dewaele et al. (2012) pressure calibration; B2 KCl is not stable at zero pressure.

## Automatic selections

- **Equilibrium:** [kcl\_b2\_dewaele\_2012\_vinet\_3](#record-kcl_b2_dewaele_2012_vinet_3)
- **Hugoniot:** None

Full comparison report: `docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json` (this record's identifier).

Explicit composite B2-KCl reference isotherm. Campbell and Heinz report V0(B2)/V0(B1)=0.8483+/-0.0057, K0=28.7+/-0.6 GPa, and K0'=4 constrained over 2-56 GPa. The absolute B2 V0 is 0.8483\*62.36=52.899988 A^3/formula unit, using the independently published experimental B1-KCl V0 of Dewaele et al. (2012). Its 0.355452 A^3 uncertainty propagates the Campbell ratio error only; Dewaele et al. report no B1 V0 error or covariance. This composite is not presented as a single-paper Campbell parameter set.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

Full comparison report: `docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json` (this record's identifier).

Walker et al.'s preferred bold Table 3 B2-KCl BE1 result is staged: the fictive V0=53.53 A^3 reference is held fixed while K0=23.7 GPa and K0'=4.4 are fitted to the room-temperature data, then Equation BE1 fits the directly reported alpha0\*K0=0.0275+/-0.0009 kbar/K thermal-pressure coefficient to the P-V-T data. The separate italic Table 3 row is a simultaneous four-parameter solution (V0=55.25 A^3, K0=14.8 GPa, K0'=6.9, alpha0=0.00018 K^-1) and is not this record. The paper states that individual parameter errors are not meaningful because of correlation, so only the published error of the identifiable alpha0\*K0 product is retained. The represented data span 3.18-8.14 GPa and 23-600 degC.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

The final article reports gamma0=2.3+/-0.2 and q=0.8+/-0.2 and defines theta(V)=theta0\*exp\[(gamma0-gamma(V))/q\], the integrated-Gruneisen Debye law. <details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Room-temperature Brillouin velocities and XRD volumes yield elastic/Debye inputs; joint fit includes Walker low-pressure data on the Matsui acoustic primary scale. Thermal extension uses experimentally inferred gamma0 and theta0 within the quasi-harmonic approximation (Section 3).
- **V0:** Table 1: 32.48(9) cm3/mol converted to angstrom3 per conventional B2 cell with Z=1 using exact N\_A=6.02214076e23/mol; multiply by 1e24/N\_A.
- **K0:** Table 1: KT0=21.33(70) GPa; Equation 15 is isothermal KT(V).
- **K0 prime:** Table 1: 4.836(83).
- **Thermal.theta0:** Table 1: thetaD0=251(22) K; deposited S1 acoustic Debye data use two-atom number density, differing from printed Equation 9.
- **Thermal.gamma0:** Table 1: 1.92(11), inferred from Debye-temperature-volume fit.
- **Thermal.q:** Equations 13-14: q found close to and fixed at 1.
- **Thermal.n:** Equation 20: two atoms per KCl formula unit.
- **Thermal.tr:** Equations 18-20 subtract thermal energy at fixed volume and 300 K.
- **Thermal.debye temperature law:** Equations 13-14: theta(V)=theta0\*exp\[(gamma0/q)\*(1-(V/V0)^q)\]. Zero-point term in Equation 20 cancels in the thermal increment.

</details>
